command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-08. Install the newest native Ollama this host's driver can actually run, and
# repeat the compatibility proof against it.
#
# The scan settled the version question with evidence rather than preference: EVERY published release
# ships a cuda_v12 runner built with cudart 12.8, which driver 560.94 (CUDA 12.6) cannot load -- that
# is the exact PTX-toolchain failure v0.32.15 hit. Only v0.6.0 through v0.9.2 ALSO ship a cuda_v11
# runner (cudart 11.3), and CUDA 11.3 loads on this driver and supports Pascal sm_61 natively. So
# v0.9.2 is the newest native Ollama that can drive this P40 without touching the host GPU driver.
#
# Versions are installed side by side under explicit version-named directories and the service names
# one of them outright. Nothing here resolves "latest" at runtime -- that is the same defect
# start-hermes.ps1 has with `docker compose pull`, and this lane should not reintroduce it in a new
# place while claiming to heal it.

$rootDir = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama'
$stage = "$rootDir\_install"
$P40 = 'GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
$smi = 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe'

Write-Output '--- ROLLBACK-BEFORE ---'
Get-ChildItem $rootDir | Select-Object Name, Mode | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80
Write-Output "d_free_gb=$([math]::Round((Get-Volume -DriveLetter D).SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2))"
if ((Test-Path "$rootDir\dist") -and -not (Test-Path "$rootDir\v0.32.15")) {
    Rename-Item "$rootDir\dist" 'v0.32.15'
    Write-Output 'renamed dist -> v0.32.15 (the version it actually is; nothing is deleted)'
}
Write-Output "ROLLBACK_PROCEDURE=Remove-Item -Recurse -Force '$rootDir'   # the whole tree is this lane's; it did not exist before MIG-03"

$target = "$rootDir\v0.9.2"
if (-not (Test-Path "$target\ollama.exe")) {
    Write-Output '--- FETCH-v0.9.2 ---'
    $zip = "$stage\v0.9.2.zip"
    $url = 'https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v0.9.2/ollama-windows-amd64.zip'
    & curl.exe -L --fail --silent --show-error -o $zip $url 2>&1 | Out-Null
    Write-Output "curl_rc=$LASTEXITCODE bytes=$((Get-Item $zip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Length)"
    $h = (Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
    Write-Output "zip_sha256=$h"
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
    [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory($zip, $target)
    Remove-Item $zip -Force
    Write-Output "extracted_to=$target"
}
Write-Output "ollama_exe=$(Test-Path "$target\ollama.exe") bytes=$((Get-Item "$target\ollama.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Length)"
Get-ChildItem "$target\lib\ollama" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "runner_dir=$($_.Name)" }
Get-ChildItem "$target\lib\ollama\cuda_v11" -Filter '*.dll' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 6 | ForEach-Object { "cuda_v11 $($_.Name) $($_.VersionInfo.FileVersion)" }

function Store-Fingerprint($label) {
    $b = Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models\blobs' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Sum Length
    Write-Output "STORE_$label blobs=$($b.Count) bytes=$($b.Sum)"
}
Store-Fingerprint 'BEFORE'

Write-Output '--- START-SERVE-11435-cuda_v11 ---'
$env:OLLAMA_HOST = '127.0.0.1:11435'
$env:OLLAMA_MODELS = 'D:\HermesData\ollama\models'
$env:CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES = $P40
# The store lost four unreferenced blobs the first time native Ollama touched it. Nothing referenced
# them and all five models stayed complete, but a commissioning lane does not get to delete from the
# owner's library as a side effect. NOPRUNE off from here on, in the proof and in the service.
$env:OLLAMA_NOPRUNE = '1'
# Left to itself Ollama would pick cuda_v12 on a 12.6 driver and die exactly as v0.32.15 did. This is
# the whole reason v0.9.2 was chosen: it still ships the runner that works.
$env:OLLAMA_LLM_LIBRARY = 'cuda_v11'
$out = "$stage\v092-serve.out.log"; $err = "$stage\v092-serve.err.log"
Remove-Item $out, $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$p = Start-Process -FilePath "$target\ollama.exe" -ArgumentList 'serve' -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
Write-Output "serve_pid=$($p.Id)"

$ready = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 750
    try { $v = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/version' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output "READY api_version=$($v.version)"; $ready = $true; break } catch { }
}
Write-Output "ready=$ready"

if ($ready) {
    Write-Output '--- API-TAGS ---'
    $tags = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 30
    Write-Output "model_count=$($tags.models.Count)"
    $tags.models | Sort-Object name | ForEach-Object { "model=$($_.name) size=$($_.size) digest=$($_.digest.Substring(0,16)) family=$($_.details.family) params=$($_.details.parameter_size) quant=$($_.details.quantization_level)" }
    Write-Output '--- API-OPENAI-COMPAT ---'
    try { $oa = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/v1/models' -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output "v1_models_count=$($oa.data.Count) ids=$(($oa.data.id | Sort-Object) -join ',')" } catch { Write-Output "v1_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

    Write-Output '--- GENERATE-ON-P40 ---'
    foreach ($m in @('llama3.2:3b', 'qwen3:4b-instruct')) {
        $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
        try {
            $body = @{ model = $m; prompt = 'Reply with exactly one word: commissioned'; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 24; temperature = 0 } } | ConvertTo-Json
            $g = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 600
            $sw.Stop()
            Write-Output "OK $m wall_ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds) response=$($g.response.Trim() -replace '\s+', ' ')"
            Write-Output "   eval_count=$($g.eval_count) eval_ns=$($g.eval_duration) prompt_eval_count=$($g.prompt_eval_count) load_ns=$($g.load_duration) total_ns=$($g.total_duration)"
            if ($g.eval_duration -gt 0) { Write-Output "   decode_tok_per_s=$([math]::Round($g.eval_count / ($g.eval_duration / 1e9), 2))" }
        } catch { $sw.Stop(); Write-Output "FAIL $m ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds) err=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
        Write-Output '   --- gpu right after ---'
        & $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.used,utilization.gpu,power.draw,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader
    }
    Write-Output '--- EMBEDDING-MODEL ---'
    try {
        $e = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/embed' -Method Post -Body (@{ model = 'snowflake-arctic-embed2:latest'; input = 'commissioning probe' } | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 300
        Write-Output "embed_ok dims=$($e.embeddings[0].Count)"
    } catch { Write-Output "embed_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
    Write-Output '--- API-PS ---'
    try { (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/ps' -TimeoutSec 20).models | ForEach-Object { "loaded=$($_.name) size=$($_.size) size_vram=$($_.size_vram)" } } catch { Write-Output "ps_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
}

Write-Output '--- STOP ---'
try { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
Get-Process -Name 'ollama*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "STILL_RUNNING pid=$($_.Id) $($_.ProcessName)" }
Store-Fingerprint 'AFTER'
Write-Output '--- SERVE-LOG-KEY-LINES ---'
Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern 'inference compute|overrode visible|library|offload|CUDA error|level=ERROR|terminated|new model will fit|loaded' | Select-Object -First 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }
Write-Output '--- SERVE-LOG-TAIL ---'
Get-Content $err -Tail 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
